title.narrative: Transformative Economic Policy Programme (TEPP) - II

description.narrative: Bangladesh’s graduation from LDC status is a major milestone but brings challenges, including the loss of trade preferences and stronger export competition. Managing this transition will require effective policy responses, with the Ministry of Commerce playing a key role despite capacity constraints.
